w: From 6.30 a.m. Before his evening walk, Swamishri chanted the dhun for 27 minutes
Ultimately we have to give up everything in this world, but by giving up for the sake of God and this holy sadhu is a great thing.
Guru is the mean to the ignorance to redeem within ourselves.
By following the path shown by the Guru, we attain peace, success, and happiness
In the evening assembly, Lord Harikrishna Maharaj was honored by devotees.
The Guru Punam assembly program included speeches and bhajans on the glory and greatness of the guru.
The opening of the first ever children's magazine, 'Swaminarayan Bal Prakash', in the Swaminarayan Sampraday was performed by Swamishri.

Then Pujya Viveksagar Swami explained the glory of the guru according to the Hindu scriptures and that Swamishri is an ideal guru. Pujya Ishwarcharan Swami spoke glowingly of Swamishri's divinity and spiritual greatness.

Swamishri then inaugurated 'Yagnapurushopanishad' - an excellent photo-memorial book on Shastriji Maharaj. After being garlanded by the senior sadhus, the assembly climaxed with Swamishri's blessings, "One goes to the guru to dispel ignorance and darkness. Despite the fact that there is light outside, one's inner self is filled with darkness. For innumerable births one has the base instincts of lust, anger, greed, jealousy, delusion, attachment, etc... "The first guru, Vyasji, wrote the Purans and Mahabharat. Likewise, the first guru in the Swaminarayan Sampraday, Gunatitanand Swami, explained the glory of Shriji Maharaj. He revealed the true glory and work of Shriji Maharaj...

"Today, we find that our world has progressed tremendously but we have not progressed within our inner selves. And that is why we have conflict, immorality and sin. Man has attained physical comfort and luxury, but his thoughts have become corrupt and sinful. Consequently, one cannot desire for the good of others. These corrupt feelings are due to the fact that there is no inner illumination..." More than 40,000 devotees attended the Guru Punam Festival.
For the first time, a blood donation camp and diagnostic camp for diabetes was held during the festival.
ph: Swamishri inaugurates and displays Swaminarayan Bal Prakash

w: From 24 to 27 July a special spiritual camp for out-state volunteers of Satsang centers in Bihar, West Bengal, Orissa, Assam, Uttar Pradesh, Uttranchal, Punjab, Hariyana, Jammu Kashmir, Delhi, Rajasthan, North Maharashtra (Vidarbha), Madhya Pradesh, Chhatisgadh, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu, Kerala and Maharashtra was held in Swamishri's presence. The 381 male and 188 female satsangi volunteers came from 102 towns from 19 Indian states. The 4-day camp was presided by Swamishri during the morning and evening sessions providing spiritual guidance and motivation through his discourses. The senior sadhus also delivered enlightening lectures on various aspects of satsang. Audiovisual presentations and skits featured various aspects of satsang. The volunteers also participated by narrating their satsang experiences.

As a part of traditional murti pratishtha rituals, a Vishvashanti Mahayagna, or a World Peace Prayer was conducted in the early morning by learned Brahmins from India. In this second yagna held in two weeks in North America, hundreds of yajmans performed the rituals in one of 84 yagna pits.

Swamishri also graced the yagna and took part in the vidhi, during which he bathed Shri Harikrishna Maharaj with panchamrut, a combination of honey, ghee, yogurt, milk, and sugar. He also performed pujan of all the murtis to be installed during the murti pratishtha. In his blessings to the yagna yajmans, Swamishri described the importance of conducting such a yagna for peace within families, within society, and all throughout the world. He explained that, "such a yagna should be performed to please God, in fact, all of our actions should be done with this goal in mind."

Blessing the morning assembly, Swamishri said, “This world is inanimate and perishable. It is a cause of misery. If this is understood then attachment for it is overcome. Our forefathers have gone and have not taken anything with them. They have left everything and gone. One has this knowledge that they have not taken anything, but one does not understand that we also have to leave everything and go. From all this, only that which is used for God is of (real) worth. So, God and His Sadhu are true. Peace and happiness is attained through them.”

Dharmavinay Swami gave a report on the construction of the Himmatnagar mandir. As soon as he began to give the report, Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "How is the rain?" Then, when Yogikrushna Swami, who had come from Bhuj, came to serve, he asked him too, "How is the rain?" When Munidarshan Swami came with a dish, he asked him too, "How is the rain in Bhadra?" In this way, even while eating, Swamishri was concerned about the rain. However, through Swami's prayers, God had made everything green and flourishing everywhere. There was good news of rain everywhere.

Paramvivek Swami and Gnanvardhan Swami gave details of their studies and, at the end, garlanded Pramukh Swami Maharaj with a sanctified mogra (jasmine) garland of Shastriji Maharaj that they had brought from Sarangpur.
Accepting the garland, Swamishri said, "Like the garland, become soft, become fragrant, become humble. However much you study, the spirit of being a servant and of humility should remain."

In the evening there was an organisational meeting. Pramukh Swami Maharaj came first of all and took his seat. Swamishri sat in the meeting almost continuously for three and a half hours without a break. After the meeting was over, and after finally giving prasad to the trustees, Swamishri came to his room, and the sadhus requested, "Please rest."
Swamishri said, "That's it! Just go to sleep?"
Even at the end of a three and a half hour meeting, Swamishri was just as energetic.

Dharmavinay Swami gave a report on the building of the Himmatnagar mandir. As soon as he began to give the report, Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "How is the rain?" Then when Yogikrishna Swami, who had come from Bhuj, came to serve, he asked him too, "How is the rain?" When Munidarshan Swami came with a dish, he asked him too, "How is the rain in Bhadra?" In this way, even while eating, Swamishri was concerned about the rain. Anyway, through Swami's prayers, Bhagwan had made everything green and joyful everywhere. There was good news of rain from everywhere.

Paramvivek Swami and Gnanvardhan Swami gave details of their studies, and finally placed on Pramukh Swami Maharaj a garland of jasmine flowers sanctified by Shastriji Maharaj, which they had brought from Sarangpur.
Accepting the garland, Swamishri said, "Be soft like the garland, be fragrant, be humble. However much you study, the feeling of being a servant and humility must remain."

In the evening there was a meeting about the organisation. Pramukh Swami Maharaj was the first to come and take his seat. Swamishri sat in the meeting without a break for about three and a half hours. After the meeting ended and he had finally given prasad to the trustees, Swamishri came to his room, and the sants requested, "Please rest."
Swamishri said, "That's it! Just go to sleep?"
Even at the end of a three and a half hour meeting, Swamishri was just as lively.
Today, after a group photo with the volunteers, Mahant Swami Maharaj himself asked, "How many are PRs (permanent residents)? How many are still left?"
At Swamishri's question everyone raised their hands. Then everyone prayed in one voice, "Swami! Please give your blessings that we become PRs of Akshardham."
Swamishri said joyfully, "We are already in Akshardham."

Yesterday, during both meal darshans, Mahant Swami Maharaj had had chocolate given to the children as prasad. Keeping this in mind, a plate of chocolates was ready now. When the sadhus went to give the chocolates to the children, Swamishri stopped them and called them close, saying, "Bring it here." Then he touched all the chocolates. He said to the children, "This is prasad, not chocolate."
Then, revealing the secret of touching them, he said, "If they go just like that, they become chocolate, and if they go from here, they are prasad."

ds.t: Faith in the one who speaks truly
w: Mahant Swami Maharaj came to the ongoing night session of the "Bhagya Jagya Re..." shibir. A question and answer session full of memories began with Swamishri. In it one question was asked: "You are Aksharbrahman. Shriji Maharaj dwells in you completely. Countless millions of universes float in each pore of your body. How can we come to be convinced of this?"
"Faith," Swamishri said with a smile.

Then he said, "How does faith come? Because he speaks the truth. Once he is proven to speak the truth, then everything he says proves to be true. Maharaj is true. He is Bhagwan. He is supreme. Everything is true. That is faith."
Narayanmunidas Swami asked, "How can we have faith in the matter of the manifest form?"
Swamishri said, "Maharaj has said, 'Our vine will carry on.' And Karunashankar has just said it." Saying this, he laughed heartily.
